cards.key: Paolo Banchero is out, so Desmond Bane and Franz Wagner and Nikola Vucevic should play more than usual.
Tyrese Haliburton is out, so Quenton Jackson and Andrew Nembhard and Larry Nance should play more than usual.
Asa Newell is out, so Jalen Johnson and Dyson Daniels and Aaron Wiggins should play more than usual.
Evan Mobley and Sam Merrill are out, so Craig Porter Jr. should play more than usual.
Trey Murphy and Yves Missi are out, so Dejounte Murray and Herbert Jones and Karlo Matkovic should play more than usual.
Lauri Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr. are out, so Kyle Filipowski and Darryn Peterson and Brice Sensabaugh should play more than usual.
Stephen Curry is out, so De'Anthony Melton and Yaxel Lendeborg and Charles Bassey should play more than usual.

outs.note: The show said Trey Murphy III and Bennedict Mathurin are doubtful for Nov. 13, and Yves Missi could return. Murphy has not played since Nov. 8. The show said Jordan Poole gets a bump and is playable for value.
Yves Missi has a left knee contusion and bone bruise from Oct. 23 and has missed every game since. He is listed as doubtful for Friday against Memphis.

The show said Evan Mobley is out on Nov. 13. He played 33 minutes on Nov. 11. The show said this is a big bump for Jarrett Allen, though it called the matchup with Bam Adebayo and Giannis Antetokounmpo tough for Allen.
Sam Merrill is out for the Nov. 13 slate and has not played since Nov. 6.
Capela started on Oct. 30 with Alperen Sengun and Steven Adams out, but he is now out himself. He missed Nov. 2 with a right ankle sprain.

The show said Marcus Smart is out on Nov. 13. He has played 17 to 20 minutes off the bench lately. The show said Reed Sheppard and Tari Eason get bumps, though they are not in great spots against Utah.

Curry left after six minutes with an abdominal injury, and Shams Charania reported it is an oblique abdominal tear with a re-evaluation in two weeks. The show said he will not be back in two weeks and expects him to miss over a month.

The show said Zach Edey is out on Nov. 13. He started and played 20 minutes on Nov. 11. The show expects more minutes for Isaiah Stewart and a bump for Jerami Grant, and it said Zion Williamson should have a big game for New Orleans without Edey.
The show said Williams is probably out for the entire season. He has not played since Oct. 25.
Chet Holmgren is out eight to 10 weeks with a small patellar tendon tear and will not need surgery. He has not played since Oct. 25.
Jaylin Williams missed his fourth straight game Tuesday with back spasms.
The show said Wallace is presumably out for the season. He has not played since Oct. 25.

injuries.text: The show said Aaron Nesmith got hurt in the Nov. 11 game and could be out on Nov. 13. He played 22 minutes on Nov. 11 for 2 points after playing 34 minutes on Nov. 9. The show said Kelly Oubre Jr. becomes its favorite Pacers value play if Nesmith sits.

Joel Embiid left early in the first quarter after banging knees with Ja'Kobe Walter, but he returned later in the quarter. He finished with 20 points in 28 minutes, and the show said he moved as well as he has in quite some time.
